data.name: Demon's March
data.detailed_description:
Currently In active development, Wishlist to stay tuned in for trailers, demos and eventual release!


Demon's March is an old-school first-person dungeon crawler blobber RPG with tactical round-based party combat, made to be a spiritual successor to classic western CRPGs like Wizardry, Might and Magic, or Bard's Tale.  

Your party awakens, washed upon an unknown shore. Once great heroes, now amnesic and stripped of power. Can you survive the hostile landscape, uncover the mystery of how and why you're here, and stop the looming march of evil? 

Features:

  • Real-time grid-less and map-less exploration

  • Initiative/round-based "give orders and go" tactical party combat with positioning

  • Enemy patrols you can ambush/be ambushed by

  • Attrition mechanics with health, energy, fatigue and limited resting

  • Create up to 3 characters with customizable Attributes, Traits (classless system), appearance, personality and speech pitch

  • Party size of 1-8, with optional ironman/permadeath mode

  • Multiple interconnected overworld maps complete with secrets and dungeons

  • Mystery-style story with many characters to speak to and recruit into your party

  • Dozens of combat abilities, dozens of hand-drawn enemies, 100+ items

  • Old-school dark fantasy presentation with original, hand-crafted soundtrack

data.short_description: Demon's March is an old-school first-person dungeon crawler party RPG with tactical round-based combat. Create your characters, fight 40+ hand drawn enemies, find 100+ items, and meet/recruit several NPCs to survive the hostile landscape, uncover the mystery and stop the looming march of evil!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer (64 bit required)
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: WebGPU-compatible graphics device
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
